node.statement: For arbitrary n choose a power of two m>=n. Node 1.3.2 gives a_n>=a_m, while node 1.3.3 gives a_m>=r_+ and node 1.1 gives r_+>=1-C_diag*e. Hence ||T_n(Z)||>=a_n||Z||>=(1-C_diag*e)||Z|| for every Z. The constants are universal and e_diag is positive, proving the root contract.
